rules: Only existing responses; cache misses fail closed.
Existing observed channels are not new independent measurements.
A retrospective subset test must recompute its conditioning posterior.
Every new-noise simulation is labeled simulated, not observed hardware data.

E1.shared_gain: one persistent proper truncated real gain per episode; never per frequency
E1.noise_convention: P2 real variance sigma^2, complex total variance 2*sigma^2
E1.frequency_dispersion: constant epsilon radial calibration benchmark only; separate causal-model stress target
E1.polarization: existing two transverse channels; span/redundancy control only on radial isotropic support
E1.nonconcentric_vector_branch: separate approval and budget; not auto-started

E3.primary_endpoint: true full material MAE at matched total cost

statistics.mae_normalization: fixed prespecified physical scale, never truth-dependent
statistics.model_mismatch_panels: reported separately, not pooled with in-model performance

go_no_go_proposals.E1: same cost >=10% relative MAE improvement OR >=20% acquisition-cost saving at matched MAE, paired interval excludes zero; no meaningful coverage deterioration
go_no_go_proposals.ROM: same accepted utility/decision quality, >=20% inclusive end-to-end savings including refresh, or disable ROM
go_no_go_proposals.graph: retain only if measurable quality/cost benefit over direct risk computation
go_no_go_proposals.notes: Engineering relevance thresholds proposed before experiments, not physical laws or already passed gates.
